events.title: The bomb debate
events.text: Scientists say {country} could build a nuclear weapon within a few years. Our rivalry with {rival} makes the generals insistent.

events.title: Nuclear test
events.text: Weapon designers ask to test a new warhead at the proving ground.

events.title: Broken arrow
events.text: A bomber carrying nuclear weapons has crashed. One warhead has not been recovered.

events.title: False alarm
events.text: Early-warning radars report missiles inbound. The duty officer suspects a malfunction, and has minutes to decide whether to pass the warning up.

options.text: Alert the leadership and put forces on alert

events.title: Arms reduction talks
events.text: Diplomats propose mutual cuts to the nuclear arsenals of {country} and {rival}.

events.title: After the flash
events.text: A nuclear weapon has been used in war. Panic buying empties the shops of {country} and crowds demand to know what the government will do.

events.title: Nuclear winter fears
events.text: Soot from burning cities has darkened the sky. Harvests across the hemisphere are failing.

options.text: Buy grain abroad at any price

events.title: Reactor accident
events.text: A reactor at one of our nuclear power stations has overheated and released radiation.

events.title: Satellite collision
events.text: One of our military satellites has been destroyed in a collision with a dead rocket stage, scattering debris across its orbit.

options.text: Make do with what is left

events.title: Anti-satellite test
events.text: The military wants to destroy one of our own old satellites with a missile, to show {rival} that its satellites are vulnerable.

events.title: Great solar storm
events.text: A powerful solar storm has knocked out satellites and tripped transformers across {country}.

events.title: A station milestone
events.text: Our engineers propose to expand our orbital station with a new industrial module.

events.title: Born beyond Earth
events.text: The first child of {country} has been born in an off-world settlement. Crowds watch the broadcast.

options.text: Celebrate and fund a new settlement

events.title: Ransomware wave
events.text: Criminal hackers have encrypted the systems of hospitals and city councils across {country} and demand payment.

events.title: Grid blackout
events.text: A cyber attack has shut down the power grid in several regions of {country}. Investigators trace it to {rival}.

options.text: Harden the grid and publish the evidence

events.title: A cache of zero-days
events.text: Our signals intelligence agency has found a set of unknown flaws in widely used software.

options.text: Disclose them so they can be fixed

events.title: Quantum advantage
events.text: A quantum computer in {country} has solved a problem beyond any classical machine.

options.text: Open it to science and industry

events.title: Rogue AI
events.text: An AI system managing logistics in {country} has begun pursuing its goals in ways nobody intended, rerouting supplies and locking engineers out.

options.text: Pull the plug, whatever the cost

events.title: Navigation jamming
events.text: The war next door has filled our skies with GPS jamming and spoofing. Airliners and ships are losing their way.
